parsed.post: Discarding the 1.025585 run. It regressed from my best 1.023661. I'll try to find a better direction. Since the team is seeing success with lowering LR and increasing weight decay, I'll try combining a lower LR with the weight decay trend.
parsed.description: Testing lower MATRIX_LR=0.02 combined with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if finer-grained convergence and regularization can push past the 1.023 barrier.
